name: OpenVibe.MediaHub

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed (an upload in flight is cut; the person resumes it from its parts)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are cookies verified against Network's keys, fetched again at boot
a chunked upload session survives the restart: its parts are in Media, and the page resumes from the missing ones until the session expires (MEDIAHUB_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS)
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0003 only create MediaHub's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the three domains

notes: Port 4990, unit openvibe-media-hub.service, one process for openvibe.download, openvibe.pics and openvibe.video (plan T10 D4, by Host header). v1: openvibe.download is a private drive — account-only uploads streamed into OpenVibe.Media (app media-hub; a plain form up to 256 MB, resumable multipart beyond), private files and folders with per-person limits, share links that expire, need a signed-in downloader and may name accounts (matched by subject), reports that suspend a share for staff, and sandboxed attachment downloads. openvibe.pics and openvibe.video answer with coming pages: their uploads wait for scanning and abuse intake (the video.*/pics.*/download.* capabilities stay planned until an app may call them). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client media-hub, JWKS, identity.subject.resolve) and OpenVibe.Media; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033).

site.name: Media Hub
site.what: The media-hub products in one service: video watch pages, chapters, captions and playlists (openvibe.video); image hosting and albums (openvibe.pics); share links, drive and backup (openvibe.download). Bytes stay in OpenVibe.Media.
